parsed.use_case: A service needs to store or transmit a hierarchical configuration or syntax tree, then rebuild it later with the same parent-child structure, including missing children. The encoding must preserve enough structural information to distinguish different trees with the same values.
system_examples: Protocol Buffers — encodes nested message structures for transmission and parsing, preserving field and nested-message boundaries.
Git — stores commit and tree objects in a serialized object format that can be read back to reconstruct repository structure.
parsed.explanation: A traversal records node values along with explicit markers for absent children, so decoding can rebuild the exact shape; this takes O(n) time and O(n) space for n nodes. Compared with repeatedly searching or rebuilding structure from incomplete data, one pass avoids ambiguity and scales predictably, which matters when trees are persisted or sent between services.ющие
